dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit high-contrast, thin-line perimeters with sharp pixel-level transitions from dark charcoal backgrounds to light-gray outlines. Prominent structures include two interlocking circular annuli in the upper-mid section and a larger, elongated 'O' shape below them, characterized by crisp, irregular boundaries and minimal internal-to-external gradient.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of solid high-intensity clusters. Observed are scattered, non-geometric micro-blobs of light-intensity pixels along the mid-dorsal ridge, measuring 3-10 pixels in diameter, lacking internal structural variation or gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three primary dorsal annuli form an obtuse triangle. The distance between the two upper annuli is approximately 1.5 times the diameter of the largest annulus, while the third centroid is positioned roughly 30 degrees below the horizontal axis connecting the first two.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of fine, high-contrast orange-toned particulates scattered across the lower-mid lateral region, contrasting with the primarily monochromatic pelage.
